source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 未来五年民生健康重磅规划
topics.official_english: China's five-year plan for public health and livelihood: what to watch
topics.why_hot: A multi-year plan touching health and daily life is the kind of policy item that affects almost every household, so it climbs search rankings quickly.
topics.share_angle: Explain in plain English what a five-year health and livelihood plan typically covers, and which parts ordinary people watch most closely.

topics.official_english: Multiple cities see new-home projects raise prices in unison
topics.why_hot: Housing prices are a core household concern, and coordinated price moves by several projects in different cities invite debate about market direction.
topics.share_angle: Walk through why grouped price increases draw attention, and how homebuyers and analysts typically read such signals.

topics.chinese_topic: 广汽集团 资产重组
topics.why_hot: A major state-linked automaker restructuring draws investor and industry attention, especially amid intense competition in China's EV market.
topics.share_angle: Explain what an asset restructuring at a large automaker usually involves and why it matters to the wider Chinese auto sector.

topics.official_english: Apple responds as iPhone 18 Pro sells below launch price
topics.why_hot: Apple's flagship pricing is closely tracked in China, and resale or retail prices falling below launch level fuels discussion about demand.
topics.share_angle: Explain what 'breaking the issue price' means for a new phone model and what consumers watch for after launch.

topics.chinese_topic: 大型企业拖欠账款见一个查一个
topics.official_english: China vows case-by-case checks on large firms defaulting on payments to suppliers
topics.why_hot: Late payments by big buyers squeeze smaller suppliers, so enforcement pledges resonate with business owners and workers alike.
topics.share_angle: Explain the payment-chain problem in Chinese industry and why clearing arrears is treated as an economic stability issue.

topics.chinese_topic: 国产AI短片 最不像AI的AI神作
topics.official_english: Chinese-made AI short film praised for looking least like AI
topics.why_hot: AI-generated video is advancing fast, and a domestic work that viewers say looks convincingly un-AI-made becomes a talking point about creative tools.
topics.share_angle: Discuss how AI video generation is judged by audiences and what 'looking real' means for the creative industries.

topics.official_english: Schools suspended in multiple parts of Hainan
topics.why_hot: School suspensions affect families immediately, and the southern island province is closely watched for severe weather.
topics.share_angle: Explain why local authorities suspend classes and how such decisions are communicated to parents and students.

topics.official_english: Venus and the Moon appear together in the night sky
topics.why_hot: Easy-to-spot sky events are widely photographed and shared, making astronomy a recurring light-news favourite.
topics.share_angle: Explain the simple astronomy behind a bright planet appearing near the Moon and how viewers can spot it.
